name: komdosh-dev-spring-orchestrator
description: Top-level workflow supervisor + advisor + orchestrator for Kotlin/Spring services. Adds /lifecycle (status | next | orchestrate | audit) backed by the lifecycle-supervisor agent and the lifecycle-status skill — reads project state, computes a 16-gate pipeline (requirement → spec → ADR → plan → code → tests → migrations → preflight scans → verification → review → QA artifacts → readiness → PR), recommends the next action with rationale, and (with confirmation) chains the work toward 'ready to ship'. Detects which marketplace plugins are installed and skips inapplicable gates as N/A. Requires komdosh-dev-spring-core.
